defects.title: PosTerminal styles.css alert colors hardcoded (lines 143-146)
defects.invariant: Foundations §1.1 — all status colors must use design-system tokens (--ds-color-*) not hardcoded hex
defects.mechanism: styles.css:143-146 defines .alert.error/.unauthorized/.conflict/.information with hardcoded hex colors (#8d2731, #efc2c6, etc.) bypassing design-system tokens
defects.acceptance: Replace hardcoded hex with --ds-color-danger/--ds-color-warning/--ds-color-info tokens; verify no hardcoded status colors remain in styles.css

defects.title: PosTerminal status dots convey state by color only (styles.css:116-121, 169)
defects.invariant: WCAG 1.4.1 — color must not be the only visual means of conveying information; status indicators need text/icon accompaniment
defects.mechanism: .system-state > span (line 116) and .system-state.online/offline/login-state (lines 117-121) use only background-color changes (green/red/gray) with no text label or icon; .system-state.login-state variants (lines 120-121) also color-only
defects.acceptance: Add visible text label or icon to each status variant; verify screen-reader accessible state announcement

defects.title: PosTerminal border-radius inconsistency: styles.css:187 uses 16px + custom shadow vs billing.css:14,34 using --ds-radius-* tokens
defects.invariant: Design-system token contract — all radii must use --ds-radius-* tokens; no ad-hoc pixel values
defects.mechanism: styles.css:187 (.table-order-bridge) hardcodes border-radius: 16px and custom box-shadow; billing.css:14 (.bill-split__header) and :34 (.bill-split__editor section) use --ds-radius-md/--ds-radius-sm tokens correctly — divergence confirms token non-adoption in styles.css
defects.acceptance: Replace hardcoded 16px with --ds-radius-lg (or --ds-radius-md per token scale); replace custom shadow with --ds-shadow-raised; verify primitives.css tokens used throughout

limitations: Source analysis is static (code reading only); runtime visual verification not performed. No browser screenshot or accessibility tree capture available. Evidence limited to CSS source files at HEAD commit 8c03e79.
